create_load_model: load a causal language model using AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained with auto dtype
create_load_tokenizer: load a tokenizer using AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained for a given model ID
run_quantize_oneshot: apply FP8 quantization with multiple strategies using llmcompressor oneshot and a YAML recipe
run_dispatch_model: dispatch and offload a quantized model using compressed_tensors dispatch_model
run_save_quantized_model: save a quantized model and tokenizer to disk in compressed-tensors format
